hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(\.env"|app\.db"|credentials|\.local\.json")' && echo 'BLOCKED: Sensitive file — confirm with user before editing .env, app.db, credentials, or .local.json files' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0
hooks.description: Block edits to sensitive files (.env, app.db, credentials, .local.json)

hooks.command: for f in $CLAUDE_EDITED_FILES; do if [[ "$f" == *.py ]]; then /opt/homebrew/bin/ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" 2>/dev/null; .venv/bin/python -m py_compile "$f" || echo "SYNTAX ERROR in $f"; fi; done
hooks.description: Auto-lint with Ruff + syntax check after every Python edit

hooks.command: for f in $CLAUDE_EDITED_FILES; do if [[ "$f" == *.ts || "$f" == *.tsx ]]; then cd frontends/sakura && npx tsc --project tsconfig.app.json --noEmit --pretty 2>&1 | tail -20; break; fi; done
hooks.description: Auto-check TypeScript types after every edit
